messages:
maria_cs: Kicking off quota surge probe for Vega's Dedicated pool tomorrow 2026-03-22 10:00 PT. Goal: validate autoscale, fallback, and cache priming. Who's joining?

tim_ops: I'll join. What's peak QPS target? Also need warmup tokens for prefix KV cache priming. :thumbsup:

olivia_engineer: Product handed off 6k qps sustained, 9k burst. Plan: 3 phases (ramp 15m, steady 30m, spike 10m). I'll push load script to infra repo.

raj_reliability: Add canary route on pool `vega-pri` -> fallback `vega-lite` for 429/503. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vega-capacity (edited)

maria_cs: SRE, confirm autoscale policy: min_nodes=2, target_cpu=65%, scale_step=+2 nodes on thresholds?

tim_ops: Confirmed base policy, changing scale_step to +3 for spike window. Increase grace_period to 90s. I'll apply.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging:load-generator v1.4 deployed to staging (hash: a1b2c3) :rocket:

olivia_engineer: Load script (k6) snippet I'm using:
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 15m script.js
// ramp: add 100 vus every 2m
```
Also using header `x-vega-test:true` to route to dedicated pool.

tim_ops: Reminder: run KV cache priming before steady phase: curl to /v1/cache/prime with sample prefixes. Example:
```
curl -X POST "https://staging.redwood/api/v1/cache/prime" -d '{"prefix":"vega-","count":2000}'
```

jess_observe: Dashboards wired: latency_p95, latency_p99, error_rate, 429_count, node_count, token_cost. Alerts: error_rate >5% for 5m, sustained p99>1.2s for 10m.

maria_cs: We'll capture customer-facing notes. If errors >5% sustained during steady, flag renewal risk and schedule exec sync.

tim_ops: I'll run fallback DR at +5m into the spike: force route to vega-lite and verify <1% error.

olivia_engineer: Post-test checklist: attach load logs, autoscale timeline, grafana links, and diff of token cost. I'll collect artifacts.

maria_cs: Thanks all — I'll send calendar invite + pre-req checklist. Tagging @alex_sales to join for customer visibility.

alex_sales: I'll be on the call. Will take notes for the QBR and escalate if anything smells like renewal risk.

maria_cs: Perfect. 1-2 quick asks before we wrap: 1) confirm warmup script location, 2) owner for postmortem?

tim_ops: Warmup script: infra/load/warmups/vega_warmup.py. Postmortem owner: @raj_reliability.

raj_reliability: Got it, will own postmortem and SLA impact calc.

maria_cs: Great — see you tomorrow. :tada:
